The issuer exhibits very strong financial performance with substantial revenue ($23,993M) and solid margins (70% gross, 30% operating), backed by a massive asset base ($192,816M) and significant retained earnings ($167,281M). However, its liquidity is relatively tight for a highly-rated credit, with a current ratio of 1.07 (current assets of $54,611M vs. current liabilities of $50,869M) and a leveraged capital structure (total liabilities of $113,539M vs. equity of $79,277M). These metrics support a solid investment-grade rating, reflecting very strong capacity to meet financial commitments but tempered by leverage and tight short-term liquidity.

DECISION: A-
